notes.body: Baseline block, 8 to 27 July 2026. Thirteen rides, 7.9 hours actual riding, about 3 hours a week. Eighty one percent of that time was tempo or harder, which held under every plausible HRmax assumption from 172 to 190. The cause was a broken anchor rather than poor discipline: Zwift's FTP field read 146 W, which is above his best 5 minute power and physiologically impossible, so Zwift's Zone 2 displayed as 82 to 110 W and he rode it faithfully. Against a real threshold near 115 W that band is tempo. Two independent methods agreed once the FTP was corrected. Ramp test on 27 July set FTP at 115 W, threshold heart rate 152, observed max 169. Heart rate has a very high floor: going from 40 W to 100 W moved it about 12 beats, which is the fastest adapting thing in his physiology and the reason the benchmark ride exists. Cardiac drift of about 8 bpm at matched power is unresolved between aerobic base and Dubai heat, and a second fan plus electrolytes is the experiment that separates them.

Cycling contributes roughly 5 percent of the deficit, about 984 kcal a week or 140 kcal a day of mechanical work. Diet does the rest. Intake target 2,400 to 2,500 kcal against an estimated maintenance of 3,000, which is an estimate and the scale trend is the measurement. Breakfast is the weakest meal. The weekly takeaway stays, because eliminating enjoyed food predicts relapse.
